Name: Light Mod REDUX
Author: klatuprism
Description:
This is a continuation of aedenthorn's original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14387]Light Mod[/url].

[size=5][b]Light Manipulation
[/b][/size]
To adjust the intensity of an object's light source, hover over its base tile and use the scroll wheel. For smaller incremental changes, hold down [b]Left Shift[/b] or for even smaller changes [b]Left Control. [/b]This also works for ambient light glows (sunlight, etc.).

To adjust the radius of an object's light, hover over its base tile and use the scroll wheel while holding down [b]Left Alt[/b]. For smaller incremental changes, hold down [b]Left Shift[/b] or for even smaller changes [b]Left Control[/b].

To turn a light on or off manually, hover over its base tile and press the middle mouse button.

See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14387]original  mod[/url] for more details

[size=5][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
Please note this first release still has the bug that if you move a lamp while it is turned on a ghost light source will be left behind.  The workaround is to turn the lamp off before you move it.   If you do get a ghost light source just place another lamp in the centre of the source and turn it  off,  this will remove the ghost source.  I hope to have the issue resolved in a near future release.  When you reload the save the ghost will also be removed.
